company_overview: Postman is an API platform that simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration so developers can create better APIs faster. It is recognized as the world’s leading API platform, serving developers and enterprises worldwide.
target_audience: Software engineers and API developers working in enterprise environments who need to build, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services.

company_overview: Supabase is an open-source Postgres development platform that provides a fully managed database, authentication, real-time, storage, and edge functions. It offers instant APIs, AI integration, and enterprise-grade security for rapid prototyping and scaling.
target_audience: AI builders, enterprise innovation teams, and startups looking to prototype and scale applications.

company_overview: Vapi is a unified platform that lets builders create, deploy, and improve voice AI agents quickly, with enterprise‑grade scalability, security, and compliance. It offers orchestration, real‑time monitoring, and configurable guardrails to support millions of calls with sub‑500 ms latency.
target_audience: Small businesses to global enterprises looking to build and deploy advanced voice AI agents.
